c5.note: predatory recall 4/4 on IJISRT by ISSN (2456-2165); 0 FP on BMJ/RES/NAR/CVPR/Science; hijacked path unit-tested only — no stable hijacked DOI in set

c1_v2.note: Recall 0.82 on hard (fabricated) fakes was always there — original 0.26 was a dataset artifact (perturbed fakes retained real title tokens, so Crossref resolved them as real). FP ~0.21-0.23 is unchanged: fuzzy title-matching against Crossref query.bibliographic has a ~1-in-5 false-positive floor on messy/DOI-less references. DOI-direct was kept as a principled no-regression addition but did not measurably reduce FP on this DOI-sparse dataset. Lenient top-N matching cut FP to 0.15 but crashed recall (0.82→0.45) and was rejected. Advisory stance confirmed.

before_hard.note: Fair recall on fabricated fakes — this is the real capability number

lenient_easy.note: Lenient top-N matching cut FP but tanked recall — rejected tradeoff

after_easy.note: DOI-direct addition; FP essentially unchanged (+0.02), recall unchanged. DOI-sparse dataset — DOI-direct benefit not measurable here.

after_hard.note: DOI-direct addition; FP essentially unchanged (+0.02), recall unchanged at 0.82

c1_cleaning.feature: pdf-extract clean_reference() strips arXiv-HTML citation-key noise (BZB + [19], FAHA [23], bare [12]) at the _result chokepoint
c1_cleaning.calibration_impact: NONE — clean_reference is a no-op on all 476 calibration refs (they carry no citation-key prefix), so c1 recall (0.82 hard) and FP are provably unchanged. Verified by diffing, not re-running the 20-min eval.
c1_cleaning.honest_finding: Cleaning works (the BZB+/FAHA/HCB+ prefixes are gone from the ref strings) but did NOT reduce the unresolved/FP ratio: BitNet 0.50->0.50, LoRA 0.55->0.55, KAN 0.125->0.10 (one extra resolved). The spec hypothesis -- that stripping the leading citation key would let Crossref match -- was WRONG: Crossref query.bibliographic is already robust to the small leading-key token fraction; author+title tokens dominate the match. The real FP driver is the matcher/Crossref ranking (the prior c1_v2 finding), which loosening would trade for recall. clean_reference is kept as a correct, no-regression output-hygiene improvement (cleaner reference strings, idempotent, 0 recall impact), NOT an FP fix. The genuine C1-FP lever is a second resolver source (round 3).
